messages:
maria: heads-up: ginkgo11b-int4 canary hit intermittent OOMs during medium-length generative tests (~140-220 tokens). pattern looks like tokenization boundary + KV growth + fragmentation. posting short logs and repro.
samir: run id? config?
maria: run=ginkgo-canary-6188, cfg=batch=5 microbatch=384k max_new_tokens=256 prefetch=on kv_cache=enabled quant=perchannel-int4
logs:
```
[2026-03-25T09:10:12Z] ERROR allocator: cudaOutOfMemoryError allocate 1.6GB
[2026-03-25T09:10:12Z] WARN mem-frag: freelist fragments 850MB after gc
[2026-03-25T09:10:13Z] INFO evict: soft-evict reclaimed 120MB
[2026-03-25T09:10:13Z] WARN kernel-selector: fallback to gemm-small for layer 6 due to alignment
```
ben: that freelist peak is high. two quick triage steps: (1) reduce microbatch -> 256k and lower max_new_tokens -> 160 for canary; (2) run a targeted quant calibration including token-boundary-heavy and long-gen prompts (we only used general corpus).
maria: applying config change now. infra?
ops-bot: patching ginkgo-canary-6188: microbatch=256k max_new_tokens=160 rolling-restart nodes [gpu-h1-02]
ops-bot: routing unchanged, trace-sample=1%
samir: also try a temporary tokenizer-normalization AB: join-digit-decimal vs default. token splits + int4 small-probability shifts can flip greedy choices. route 10% to token-join preproc if easy.
ben: agree. try layer-protect last1 (fp16) too on a small fraction — if the head is sensitive it should recover quality.
maria: kicked targeted calibration (calib-ginkgo-toklong-6188) with KL+MSE, and started AB: token-join=10%, layer-protect-last1=10%. will post short eval in ~20m.
After 25m:
maria: quick status: patched canary logs show fewer OOMs, freelist peaks down to ~420MB after GC, soft-evict reclaimed ~200MB on large gens. sample:
```
[09:36:02] INFO config: microbatch=256k max_new_tokens=160
[09:36:15] INFO request 14321 tokens=180 kv_size=36MB -> success
[09:36:42] WARN mem-frag: freelist peak 420MB after gc
```
ben: good. what about quality on token-join and layer-protect arms? any regressions?
maria: token-join currency/math tests improved a lot on short numbers, no quality regressions on general suites so far. layer-protect arm shows small quality gain on reasoning prompts but p50 latency +9ms.
samir: next steps: (A) finish calib with numeric/long-gen corpus and compare per-channel KL+MSE vs current; (B) keep microbatch=256k and max_new_tokens=160 as interim defaults for ginkgo canary; (C) add a per-model heuristic: if freelist_peak>600MB -> auto-reduce microbatch or trigger heap_reserve=1GB as fail-safe.
ops-bot: config saved. will alert on freelist_peak>600MB for canary.
maria: will attach failing token dumps and raw logits from the early repros to the ticket. thanks all — will update when calib finishes. ping me for traces. :thumbsup:
